component.name: Cove
component.summary: A calm launcher for all your games

description.p: Cove brings your games from Steam, GOG, Epic, Amazon, itch.io, emulators and your own folders together in one tidy library. No ads, no social feed, no account of its own.

ul.li: Sign in to Steam, GOG, Epic and Amazon on the store's own page; Cove never sees your password
Install, update and play GOG, Epic and Amazon games without their launchers
Run Windows games with Proton (GE-Proton or Steam's), through umu-launcher
Per game: MangoHud, gamescope, AMD FSR, DXVK and VKD3D-Proton
Save backups for every game, and cloud saves for GOG and Epic
ROM folders per system with RetroArch or a standalone emulator
Playtime, achievements, statistics, a catalogue and recommendations computed on your computer

description.p: In the Flatpak, MangoHud and gamescope come from the Flathub extensions org.freedesktop.Platform.VulkanLayer.MangoHud and org.freedesktop.Platform.VulkanLayer.gamescope.
Amazon games installed through the Amazon Games app (Windows) or Heroic (Linux) are found without a login.
A TV mode for controllers: a full-screen interface for the TV and the Steam Deck, with the buttons of your controller (Xbox, PlayStation, Switch, Steam Deck) on screen.
Amazon Games (Prime Gaming) without the Amazon app, a wishlist with price alerts, a statistics page, and Cove as a Flatpak.
Save backups for every game, emulators and ROMs, game options on Linux, umu-launcher, GOG cloud saves, time to beat, and builds for Linux ARM64 and Intel Macs.
